# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 yuan-phase3, Quanzhou Ispah & Early Wokou Maritime Line (oe_ymar_). Generated by gen_yuan_maritime.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, reserved slot 47 "ymar") while
# OR = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_on NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_init } }.
# No monthly on_action hook of its own.
oe_ymar_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_init } } oe_ymar_setup = yes }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_m value = oe_ymar_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_on }
        oe_ymar_end_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_on current_date >= 1350.1.1 }
            oe_ymar_ev_step = yes
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
}
# Any scope. First run in a game: before 1415.1.1 while Mongol Yuan CHI stands, arm the line (events open from 1350.1.1).
oe_ymar_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_ymar_init
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1415.1.1 oe_ymar_yuan_ok = yes }
        set_global_variable = oe_ymar_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_done value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_ispah value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_policy value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_wokou value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_chen value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_tally value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_treasure value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_wait value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_last value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_ymar: the maritime line is armed (active from 1350.1.1 to 1415.1.1)"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_done value = 8 }
        debug_log = "oe_ymar: too late or no Mongol Yuan: line stays off (code 8)"
    }
}
# Any scope (F6 COLLAPSE_HOOKS interface, also checked monthly). Yuan fell: strip all modifiers and close with code 2.
oe_ymar_on_yuan_fall = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_on } oe_ymar_finish = { code = 2 } }
    else = { oe_ymar_strip = yes }
}
# Any scope, monthly. End checks: 2 Yuan fell, 1 arc completed via .8 (modifiers stay until Yuan falls), 3 reached 1415.1.1.
oe_ymar_end_check = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ymar_yuan_ok = no } oe_ymar_on_yuan_fall = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_done ?= 1 }
        remove_global_variable = oe_ymar_on
        debug_log = "oe_ymar: maritime arc completed (done = 1; lasting modifiers stay until Yuan falls)"
    }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1415.1.1 } oe_ymar_close_timeout = yes }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_ymar_finish = { code = N }: strips all modifiers and closes the line.
oe_ymar_finish = {
    oe_ymar_strip = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_on } remove_global_variable = oe_ymar_on }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_done value = $code$ }
    debug_log = "oe_ymar: the line ends (code in oe_ymar_done)"
}
# Any scope. Reached 1415.1.1 without finishing .8: close schedule cleanly (keep any policy modifiers while Yuan stands).
oe_ymar_close_timeout = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_on } remove_global_variable = oe_ymar_on }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_done value = 3 }
    debug_log = "oe_ymar: reached 1415.1.1, line closed (code 3)"
}

# Any scope. Debug counter: visible events sent by this line (global oe_dbg_n_ymar).

    change_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ymar add = 1 }
}

# Any scope, monthly from 1350.1.1. Lapses missed events and sends at most one event per month (shared oe_yuan_ev_m guard).
oe_ymar_ev_step = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ymar_lapse_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ymar_lapse_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ymar_lapse_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ymar_lapse_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ymar_lapse_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ymar_lapse_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_st_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ymar_lapse_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_st_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ymar_lapse_8 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_st_8 value = 2 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_wait } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_wait value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_ymar_busy = no global_var:oe_ymar_wait >= 2 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_ymar_due_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ymar_due_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ymar_due_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ymar_due_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 6 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ymar_due_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 7 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ymar_due_8 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 8 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ymar_due_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 5 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ymar_due_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 0 oe_ymar_busy = no }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 0 oe_ymar_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = 10 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 0 oe_ymar_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = 18 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 0 oe_ymar_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = 15 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 0 oe_ymar_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = 16 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 0 oe_ymar_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = 8 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 0 oe_ymar_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 0 oe_ymar_open_7 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 7 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 0 oe_ymar_open_8 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_pick value = 8 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 0 oe_ymar_busy = yes oe_ymar_any_due = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_wait add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 1 } oe_ymar_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 2 } oe_ymar_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 3 } oe_ymar_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 4 } oe_ymar_fire_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 5 } oe_ymar_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 6 } oe_ymar_fire_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 7 } oe_ymar_fire_7 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ymar_pick ?= 8 } oe_ymar_fire_8 = yes }
    remove_global_variable = oe_ymar_pick
}
# Any scope. One debug_log line with readouts.
oe_ymar_log = { debug_log = "oe_ymar m=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_m')|0] on=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_on')|0] done=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_done')|0] ispah=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_ispah')|0] pol=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_policy')|0] wokou=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_wokou')|0] chen=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_chen')|0] tally=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_tally')|0] treas=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_treas')|0] st=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_st1')|0][GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_st2')|0][GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_st3')|0][GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_st4')|0][GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_st5')|0][GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_st6')|0][GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_st7')|0][GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_st8')|0] wait=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_wait')|0] evm=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_evm')|0] last=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ymar_rd_last')|0]" }

# ---- TEST ONLY (DEV_LINES; current player's country scope)
oe_ymar_test_ensure = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_on } } oe_ymar_setup = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_on } } set_global_variable = oe_ymar_on set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_done value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_ispah value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_policy value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_wokou value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_chen value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_tally value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_treasure value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_wait value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_last value = 0 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_m value = oe_ymar_m_now }
}

    oe_ymar_setup = yes
    oe_ymar_log = yes
}
oe_ymar_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ymar_on } oe_ymar_monthly = yes oe_ymar_log = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ymar TEST: the line is not running (press ymarstart first)" }
}

    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ymar_d_pol value = oe_ymar_m_now }
    oe_ymar_log = yes
}
